_meta.notes: Comprehensive index of all thematic clusters (Level 4) and sub-clusters (Level 5) for Samoa.

910.name: Samoa — Cradle of Polynesia
910.description: Samoa as the heartland from which eastern Polynesian cultures developed.

sub_clusters.name: Lapita Settlement of Samoa
sub_clusters.description: Lapita pottery-makers arrive; Mulifanua ferry berth site — oldest Samoan settlement.

sub_clusters.name: Polynesian Cultural Development
sub_clusters.description: Distinctly Polynesian culture crystallises in Samoa; launching point for eastern expansion.

920.name: Pre-Contact Samoan Society
920.description: Fa'a Samoa (the Samoan Way); matai system; inter-island voyaging.

sub_clusters.name: Matai Chiefly System
sub_clusters.description: Ali'i (paramount chiefs) and tulafale (orators); title succession; fono assemblies.

sub_clusters.name: Tui Manu'a Dynasty
sub_clusters.description: One of oldest Polynesian dynasties; paramount over Manu'a Islands.

sub_clusters.name: Samoan Voyaging Traditions
sub_clusters.description: Samoan navigators expand to Tonga, Fiji, eastern Polynesia; alia double-hulled canoes.

930.name: European Contact Period
930.description: Dutch sighting; missionaries; escalating colonial rivalries.

sub_clusters.name: Early European Explorers
sub_clusters.description: Roggeveen 1722; Bougainville names 'Navigator Islands' 1768.

sub_clusters.name: London Missionary Society
sub_clusters.description: John Williams arrives 1830; rapid conversion; Christian theology integrates with fa'a Samoa.

sub_clusters.name: Tripartite Rivalry (US, UK, Germany)
sub_clusters.description: Three-way colonial competition; Samoan civil wars; 1889 Apia hurricane destroys warships.

940.name: German Samoa
940.description: Germany takes Western Samoa; plantation economy; Mau resistance begins.

sub_clusters.name: German Administration
sub_clusters.description: Governor Solf; copra and cacao plantations; Chinese and Melanesian labour.

sub_clusters.name: Early Mau Resistance
sub_clusters.description: Lauaki Namulau'ulu Mamoe leads first Mau movement; exiled to Saipan.

940.name: New Zealand Mandate
940.description: NZ seizes Samoa in WWI; misrule; Mau movement; path to independence.

sub_clusters.name: New Zealand Occupation
sub_clusters.description: NZ captures Samoa; 1918 influenza pandemic kills 22% of population.

sub_clusters.name: Mau Movement — 'Samoa for Samoans'
sub_clusters.description: Non-violent resistance; Black Saturday 1929 — police kill Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

950.name: Samoan Independence
950.description: First Pacific Island nation to gain independence in 20th century.

sub_clusters.name: Constitutional Convention
sub_clusters.description: Matai-based suffrage; blend of Westminster and fa'a Samoa governance.

sub_clusters.name: Samoa Independence (1962)
sub_clusters.description: Independence 1 January 1962; first independent Polynesian nation.

950.name: Post-Independence Development
950.description: Political development; universal suffrage; economic challenges.

sub_clusters.name: HRPP Political Dominance
sub_clusters.description: Human Rights Protection Party rules for decades; stability but democratic concerns.

sub_clusters.name: Universal Suffrage (1990)
sub_clusters.description: Shift from matai-only to universal adult suffrage; political modernisation.

960.name: Contemporary Samoa
960.description: 2009 tsunami; International Date Line switch; political transition; climate resilience.

sub_clusters.name: 2009 Samoa Tsunami
sub_clusters.description: 8.1 earthquake and tsunami; 189 killed; devastation of south coast villages.

sub_clusters.name: International Date Line Switch (2011)
sub_clusters.description: Samoa switches west of IDL to align with Australia/NZ trade partners; skips 30 December.

sub_clusters.name: 2021 Political Crisis
sub_clusters.description: FAST party wins election; PM Fiamē Naomi Mata'afa — first female PM; HRPP refuses to concede.

sub_clusters.name: Fa'a Samoa Cultural Preservation
sub_clusters.description: Fa'a Samoa endures; tapa, tatau (tattoo), siva dance; diaspora communities.

unassigned_events.note: Events in events.json not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
